desc: Nothing beats a fine Browning shotgun for a day in the field, the Maxus II Black Gold is an ideal shotgun to add to your collection of fine autoloaders. Featuring Grade III Turkish walnut with an oil finish, a beautifully engraved receiver with gold waterfowl and pheasant engravings, an Inflex II recoil pad, and three Invector-Plus choke tubes, the Maxus II Black Gold stands on its own from other hunting shotguns.
